title: ABVP holds student rally in Lucknow against political anarchy

tea.why: Protesters marched against attempts to weaken democracy, target constitutional institutions, and bring about government change through mob pressure.
tea.want: To uphold democratic values, protect constitutional institutions, and address electoral grievances through constitutional procedures.
tea.changed: Oct 18: Thousands of student activists participated in a rally from Lucknow University to Hazratganj.

summary: On October 18, 2026, thousands of student activists and members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) participated in a student rally in Lucknow under the nationwide slogan "Stop Anarchy, Embrace Democracy." The march proceeded between Lucknow University and Gandhi Chowk in Hazratganj. According to the organisers, the protest aimed to oppose political anarchy, mob pressure, and attempts to weaken democratic institutions and electoral processes. Leaders speaking at the event stated that government changes should occur exclusively through elections rather than coercion or foreign-inspired unrest. The demonstration also addressed topics such as electoral rolls and the credibility of constitutional bodies. No official government response was reported in the articles.
demands: Protect democratic values and constitutional institutions
Address electoral grievances through evidence and legal procedures rather than mob pressure
Oppose the politics of anarchy and mobocracy
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: thousands of students and ABVP members
